name: Capstone Project Phase II & Technical Documentation
overview: Final-year capstone design execution, prototype fabrication, numerical CFD/FEA validation, patent/IP filing, engineering ethics, and international IEEE/ASME publication standards.

Module 1.title: Design Realization, Rapid Prototyping & Fabrication
Module 1.textbook_html:
MODULE 01 • S8 CORE CAPSTONE

Engineering Design Realization & Prototyping

Translating CAD design specifications into physical prototypes using CNC machining, metal 3D printing (DMLS/SLM), and composite fabrication.

1. Prototyping Methodology

Modern mechanical capstone projects follow Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) guidelines, reducing part counts and optimizing tolerances for CNC subtractive and additive manufacturing workflows.

Module 2.title: Experimental Rig Design & Sensor Instrumentation
Module 2.textbook_html:
MODULE 02 • S8 CORE CAPSTONE

Experimental Setup & Data Acquisition (DAQ)

Selecting load cells, piezoelectric accelerometers, RTDs, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and NI LabVIEW DAQ interfaces for high-fidelity testing.

1. Uncertainty Analysis (Kline-McClintock Method)

Experimental Uncertainty Propagation
$$w_R = \sqrt{ \sum_{i=1}^n \left( \frac{\partial R}{\partial x_i} w_{x_i} \right)^2 }$$
Where $R = f(x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n)$ and $w_{x_i}$ is the uncertainty of each independent measured variable.

Module 3.title: Numerical Validation & Discrepancy Reconciliation
Module 3.textbook_html:
MODULE 03 • S8 CORE CAPSTONE

Numerical Validation (FEA & CFD)

Mesh convergence studies using Grid Convergence Index (GCI), comparing numerical predictions against experimental telemetry.

1. Grid Convergence Index (Roache Method)

Verifying spatial discretization independence in ANSYS/OpenFOAM CFD simulations by calculating relative errors between fine, medium, and coarse mesh solutions.

Module 4.title: Engineering Ethics, Safety Standards & IP Protection
Module 4.textbook_html:
MODULE 04 • S8 CORE CAPSTONE

Engineering Ethics, Safety & Intellectual Property

NSPE Code of Ethics, ISO 9001/14001, OSHA risk assessment, patent search, Indian Patent Office (IPO) claims drafting, and trademark law.

1. NSPE Code of Ethics Fundamental Canons

  1. Hold paramount the safety, health, and welfare of the public.
  2. Perform services only in areas of their competence.
  3. Issue public statements only in an objective and truthful manner.
  4. Act for each employer or client as faithful agents or trustees.
  5. Avoid deceptive acts and uphold honor and dignity of the engineering profession.

Module 5.title: Technical Thesis Writing & Academic Publication
Module 5.textbook_html:
MODULE 05 • S8 CORE CAPSTONE

Thesis Structure, LaTeX & IEEE Standards

Writing high-impact research manuscripts, BibTeX citation hygiene, plagiarism avoidance, executive summaries, and viva voce defense preparation.

1. Autonomous Project Report Standards

Formatting guidelines for TKMCE Autonomous Mechanical Engineering Capstone thesis: 1.5 line spacing, 12pt Times New Roman, standard chapter sequence (Introduction → Literature Survey → Methodology → Design & Analysis → Experimental Testing → Results & Discussion → Conclusion & Future Scope).
